Exact selected observer enrollment must match native-authenticated-input-v1 capture profile, authenticated-input action, actual process role and profile/package generations. Fixture receipt is root-resolved member proof, not observer enrollment ID. Missing selected observer remains pending and must be implemented by native policy/source owner.

Service independently resolves all registries/current process/source/observer. Subject is actual native managed process identity, separate root controller proof; never impersonate root as worker. PRIVATE source, exact actual current private consent/selected recipient route ceiling and zero additional budget. capture.semantics: Validate exact source selection/context/observer/schema/current peer and record event using actual SourceObserverRegistry. Retain receipt in actual authority store; do not call peer take before delivery. Returned handles are opaque registry membership, never random placeholders. Existing task capture path unchanged.

delivery.semantics: Health-specific genuine sealed queue independent task admission. Custody resolves own retained stdin pipe and current PIDFD/control; writes exact held fixture bytes once, drains/observes completed bounded write, closes stdin EOF and retains actual receipt. No caller stdin/FD/payload or direct task-origin reuse. EOF/write failure cancels health and requires descendant/terminal cleanup; no receipt mint on partial write. Capture/delivery deadlines never extend original control or source lease.

take.semantics: Current authenticated native.input.take routes retained health selection, not generic task-only dispatcher. Exact same actual peer/loaded package/profile/control/event, source store membership and successful write+EOF receipts required; take is one-use atomic. Existing bounded NativeInitialInputDelivery wire remains unchanged; proof joins are root-private. Reader/take may wait only original bounded deadline for write completion, avoiding race without new authority. Health observer closure includes source receipt, write, EOF and take; none alone proves semantic tool/provider health.
